program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const isAfterApex = t >= apexTime; const dropVelocity = isAfterApex ? -gravity * (t - apexTime) : 0; const dropAcceleration = isAfterApex ? -gravity : 0; const dropHeight = isAfterApex ? tossedHeight : apexHeight; let tossState = "At launch"; if (t > 0.05 && t < apexTime - 0.05) tossState = "Rising"; else if (t >= apexTime - 0.05 && t <= apexTime + 0.05) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime + 0.05 && tossedHeight > 0.05) tossState = "Falling"; else if (t >= apexTime + 0.05 && tossedHeight <= 0.05) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (t >= apexTime && t < apexTime + 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (t >= apexTime + 0.05 && dropHeight > 0.05) dropState = "Falling together"; else if (t >= apexTime + 0.05 && dropHeight <= 0.05) dropState = "At launch height"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 30, y: 40, w: 270, h: 360, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 340, y: 40, w: 270, h: 360, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: 50, y: 350, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 1, 2], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: 360, y: 350, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 1, 2], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const mapY = (hVal) => 350 - (hVal / 2.2) * 280; const tossY = mapY(Math.max(0, Math.min(2.2, tossedHeight))); const dropY = mapY(Math.max(0, Math.min(2.2, dropHeight))); const apexY = mapY(Math.max(0, Math.min(2.2, apexHeight))); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 165, tossY, 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", 475, dropY, 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: 145, y: tossY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: 195, y: tossY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: 455, y: dropY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: 505, y: dropY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(120, tossY - 40, [ "v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 2) + " m/s^2" ], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(430, dropY - 40, [ "v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 2) + " m/s^2" ], { id: "callout.drop" })); objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate.drop", 475, apexY, { open: isAfterApex, label: "Gate" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [ { id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration } ] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, tossedVelocity: tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration: tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight: tossedHeight, dropVelocity: dropVelocity, dropAcceleration: dropAcceleration, dropHeight: dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball with a ball dropped from the apex to see why acceleration remains constant at the top.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. Velocity and acceleration vectors illustrate forces during flight.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare velocity and acceleration at the top.
